# Draw

Draw is published by CREATE SOMETHING.

Draw is a free, local-first drawing canvas for mapping meetings and spatial notes.

## Capabilities

- Draw free-form pen strokes, rectangles, ellipses, and arrows.
- Add editable spatial notes and organize work with groups.
- Convert selected marks into notes, connectors, or groups while retaining source provenance.
- Export the canvas as JSON, SVG, or PNG and import compatible JSON documents.
- Control the visible canvas through WebMCP in compatible browsers. Inspect the current runtime tool catalog; tools vary by project mode and host support.

## Agent interface

Draw registers a semantic WebMCP surface through `document.modelContext.registerTool`: compact inspection, composition, paths, partial patches, layout, camera focus, targeted revert, dedicated destructive actions, complete state, low-level operations, selection, tool choice, history, and reset. Agent changes use the same local document, history, and persistence operations as human changes, return revision-bearing receipts, and display an on-canvas transition. Ordinary drawing mutations operate on the browser-local canvas. Explicit snapshot publishing sends document content to the Draw service. Paired native shells use their dedicated synchronization controls. A separate Python stdio adapter can connect an agent through explicit, temporary project pairing; this is not an unrestricted remote MCP endpoint.

## Data boundary

During ordinary local editing, canvas content is saved only on the current device in browser storage. Explicit snapshot publishing uploads the document to CREATE SOMETHING and creates an unlisted view-only link; anyone with that link can view it. A paired agent connection sends short-lived commands and results through the Draw service, and the connected agent provider may receive canvas content. Pair only the intended project and disconnect when finished. Exports also leave browser storage at your direction. Browser storage and installed-app state are specific to the hostname in use, so use JSON export and import when moving between origins or devices.

## Canonical URL

https://draw.createsomething.agency/

## Mac preview

https://draw.createsomething.agency/download

The Mac and iPhone companion is an individually delivered preview. The current candidate is unsigned and not notarized, so no general-public binary is linked. The landing page records the exact source revision, SHA-256 checksum, and candidate workflow receipt. A public DMG download remains held until Developer ID signing, Apple notarization, Gatekeeper verification, and clean install acceptance pass.
